text: 两块桥板断了，下面的支撑还很牢。可以修，也可以找别的路。
Two boards have split. The supports below are sound. You could repair it—or find another route.
琼把工具借给你，请你用完送回来。
June lends you a toolkit and asks you to bring it back when you are done.
琼给你指了指工作台后的通道。可以进去看看，也可以稍后再来。
June points out a passage behind the workbench. You can take a look now or come back later.
你来到修理铺的小间 1。
You arrive at Workshop annex 1.
木板虽有些旧，但结实且形状合适，足以修补断裂的桥板。
The planks are a bit worn but sturdy and suitably sized to fix the split boards.
潮汐痕迹说明储藏间地面偶尔潮湿，工具应放置高处避免生锈。
Tide marks indicate the floor gets damp sometimes; tools should be stored off the ground to prevent rust.
你来到六月修理铺。
You arrive at June’s Workshop.
琼给你指了指工作台后的通道。可以进去看看，也可以稍后再来。
June points out a passage behind the workbench. You can take a look now or come back later.
你来到修理铺的小间 2。
You arrive at Workshop annex 2.
工具架稳固地挂在墙上，且工具排列整齐，没有锈迹，说明有人定期维护。
The tool racks hang firmly on the wall, tools neatly arranged and rust-free, indicating regular upkeep.
备用木板虽有些老旧，但无明显裂纹且尺寸适宜，完全可以用来修补破损的桥板。
The spare planks are aged but free of cracks and suitably sized, perfectly usable for repairing the broken bridge boards.
你来到六月修理铺。
You arrive at June’s Workshop.

title: 修理铺后小储藏间
Back Storage Nook
detail: 修理铺后面有一个狭小储藏间，堆放着几块备用木板和一些散落的工具。墙上还有潮湿留下的潮汐痕迹，显示这里靠近海边，经常受潮。
Behind the workshop is a small storage nook with spare wooden planks stacked and some scattered tools. Tide marks on the walls show the spot is close to the sea and often damp.

label: 检查备用木板
Inspect Spare Planks
text: 木板虽有些旧，但结实且形状合适，足以修补断裂的桥板。
The planks are a bit worn but sturdy and suitably sized to fix the split boards.

label: 留意潮汐痕迹
Note the Tide Marks
text: 潮汐痕迹说明储藏间地面偶尔潮湿，工具应放置高处避免生锈。
Tide marks indicate the floor gets damp sometimes; tools should be stored off the ground to prevent rust.

title: 修理铺后隐蔽储藏室
Hidden Storage Room Behind Workshop
detail: 这间小储藏室里堆放着几块形状合适但略显陈旧的木板，墙上挂着些悬空的工具架。潮湿的地面上依稀可见潮汐留下的痕迹，工具都被安置在离地较高的架子上以防生锈。

Inside this small storage room lie a few suitably sized but somewhat aged planks. Tools hang on wall racks elevated above the damp floor, where faint tide marks remain visible, showing care to avoid rust.

label: 检查架空工具架
Inspect Elevated Tool Racks
text: 工具架稳固地挂在墙上，且工具排列整齐，没有锈迹，说明有人定期维护。
The tool racks hang firmly on the wall, tools neatly arranged and rust-free, indicating regular upkeep.

label: 确认备用木板状态
Confirm Spare Planks’ Condition
text: 备用木板虽有些老旧，但无明显裂纹且尺寸适宜，完全可以用来修补破损的桥板。
The spare planks are aged but free of cracks and suitably sized, perfectly usable for repairing the broken bridge boards.
